header.running_head: 3. The Rights and Duties of Muslims

blocks.tamil_translation: eyes the Prophet ﷺ closed, and said, “When the soul is taken, the eyes remain open, looking upward, because they keep watching the soul as it departs” (this is why Rasulullah ﷺ closed his eyes). At that time some of his household began to weep aloud (they may also have said words that should not be said). After saying, “Ask only for good Du'as for yourselves, for the angels say Ameen to your Du'a,” the Prophet ﷺ recited the Du'a (اَللّهُمَّ! اغْفِرْ لِاَبِيْ سَلَمَةَ وَارْفَعْ دَرَجَتَهُ فِي الْمَهْدِيِّيْنَ وَاخْلُفْهُ فِيْ عَقِبِهِ فِي الْغَابِرِيْنَ وَاغْفِرْلَنَا وَلَهُ يَارَبَّ الْعَالَمِيْنَ! وَافْسَحْ لَهُ فِيْ قَبْرِهِ )وَنَوِّرْ لَهُ فِيْهِ”O Allah, forgive the sins of Abu Salamah! Include him in the company of those who are rightly guided and raise his rank! Watch over his family after him! O Rabb al-Alamin! Forgive us and him! Make his grave (qabr) spacious for him! Fill his grave with light!”

blocks.text: Note:- If anyone recites this Du'a for other Muslims, let him say the name of the deceased in the place of , and also attach a lam marked with a zer before the name, for example, like .

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ ﵁ قَالَ: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ يَقُوْلُ: دَعْوَةُ الْمَرْءِ الْمُسْلِمِ لِأَخِيْهِ بِظَهْرِ الْغَيْبِ مُسْتَجَابَةٌ عِنْدَ رَاْسِهِ مَلَكٌ مُوَكَّلٌ كُلَّمَا دَعَا لِاَخِيْهِ بِخَيْرٍ قَالَ الْمَلَكُ الْمُوَكَّلُ بِهِ: آمِيْنَ، وَلَكَ بِمِثْلٍ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مسلم باب فضل الدعاء للمسلمين بظهر الغيب رقم:٦٩٢٩
blocks.tamil_translation: “The Du'a a Muslim makes for his Muslim brother in his absence is accepted. An angel is appointed near the head of the one making Du'a. Whenever he makes Du'a for the good of his brother, that angel says “Ameen”. And “For your brother,
